qa_method: Independent re-solve from stem+choices before comparing proposed answer; then classical auxiliary meaning, connection, explanation, distractor, ID, answer-position, exact-duplicate, and high-similarity review.
ambiguity_review: Completion items explicitly move from a finished event into a subsequent action; continuation items explicitly maintain the resulting state with cues such as 夜明けまで・今も・日暮れまで・そのまま. Forms with 助動詞「り」 attach only to 四段活用の已然形 in this batch (立てり・鳴けり・散れり・咲けり・着けり・住めり) or サ変動詞の未然形 (読経せり).
content_review: Confirmed that both たり and り can express completion or continuation and that たり attaches to the continuative form while り attaches to the サ変未然形 or 四段已然形. All 25 stems had one defensible answer from stem+choices alone.
release_rule: These IDs passed independent content QA but still require the future revision-bound global semantic near-duplicate gate before production-bank approval.
